datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule for Niger in 2022, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The data represents near-term projections across multiple scenarios and was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis.
